On segmental basis, our DG Set business contributed 81.4% of the overall revenue and delivered an EBITDA margin of 5.6 %, Notably, execution for orders in the MSLG business was impacted by temporary logistical challenges in transporting and installing large engine sets, the pending installations are expected to be completed in the subsequent quarters. The Wind Power business contributed 18.6% of revenue with an EBITDA margin of 48.6 %, the improvement in margin is due to seasonality impact and addition 51.3 MW in Feb-26.
